scenes.text: Hello little heroes! I'm Koko, your friendly guide today. We're going to explore an exciting adventure about screen time, which means the time we spend looking at screens like tablets or TVs. Are you ready to learn something new and fun? I promise it will be full of surprises and discoveries. Let's dive into this journey together and see what we can find!

Now, let's think about what screen time is. Screen time is when we watch our favorite shows or play games on devices. It's like when you see your favorite cartoon or when you play that exciting game. But did you know that too much screen time can make us feel tired? Just like how too much candy isn't good for our tummy, too much screen time can be not so great for our brains.

Remember when we talked about balancing things, like how we balance toys on top of each other? Well, balancing screen time is important too! We should mix screen time with other fun activities like playing outside or drawing. This way, we keep our minds and bodies strong and healthy. Can you think of a fun activity you'd like to try today?

Great job, thinking of new activities! You're doing amazing. It's important to have a variety of fun things to do, just like how superheroes have many skills. Maybe today, you can try building a fort or making a puzzle. These activities help us grow and learn new things. You can be a superhero of fun, just like me!

Let's continue our adventure by imagining our day like a big, exciting story. In this story, we have time for screens, time for playing, and time for resting. Each part is important and makes our story interesting. What would your story look like today? Maybe it starts with a screen time adventure and then moves to playing in the park.

Now, let's think about our eyes when we use screens. Did you know our eyes need a break too? Just like when we take a nap to rest, our eyes need to look away from screens sometimes. We can try the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. It’s like giving our eyes a little stretch!

Do you have a favorite screen time activity, like a game or a show? It's fun to have favorites, but remember to mix them with other activities. What other things do you like to do that aren't on a screen? Maybe you like to build with blocks or read a storybook. Tell me, what’s your favorite non-screen activity?

Let's talk about how screen time can be a learning time too. There are so many educational games and shows that teach us new things. It's like having a teacher right in our living room! But remember, learning happens in many ways, like when we explore outside or build something new. Every day can be a learning adventure.

You're doing fantastic on this journey of learning about screen time! Just like a superhero, you're discovering your strengths and how to use them wisely. Keep up the great work by trying new things and balancing your activities. Remember, every small step makes a big difference. You’re a superhero of balance!

Sometimes, screens can help us connect with family and friends who are far away. We can video call our grandparents or friends and share our stories. It's like having a special adventure together even when we're apart. But after our call, it's nice to play and explore the world around us. What’s one thing you’d like to share with someone special today?

Remember when we talked about resting our eyes? It's also important to rest our minds. After screen time, we can relax by listening to music or reading a book. It's like recharging our superhero powers! This helps us feel calm and ready for our next adventure. What’s your favorite way to relax?

Let's think about making a plan for our screen time. Maybe we can decide on a special time each day for screens, like after lunch or before dinner. Having a plan helps us know what to expect, just like a superhero mission. Can you think of a good time for your screen adventures?

You're doing an amazing job planning your screen time! Remember, it's all about finding the right balance. Just like a superhero, you have the power to make great choices. Keep exploring and trying new things, and you'll be a master of balance in no time. I'm so proud of you!

Thank you for joining me on this exciting journey about screen time. You've learned so much and discovered how to balance your adventures. Remember, you’re a superhero of fun and learning! Keep exploring, playing, and balancing. Until next time, stay curious and strong! Goodbye, little hero!
